title: RWB-P10-E2029-APP: values the sources leave open for the screening L1 app slice
source: Template and Rules v1 §R9; legacy RWB E2 029 v1; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2; context pack P10
section: 3 Preconditions; 10 Authority; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.7 Tables owned; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Five areas are named by the story but not fixed by any read-only source: (1) the per-service login of rwb-agent under DP-02; (2) the rwb-deviation (S8) story that publishes the raise operation consumed on ACCEPTED; (3) the parameter keys that carry the confidence floor 0.80, the segment values and the promotion condition of rwb-case; (4) the gateway-bff route name and path in front of the panel read; (5) the Flyway numbering of rwb_agent, which this key does not extend because the legacy story states no new table.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §12 names the S8 Java interface DeviationService.raise and names no service story behind it; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 Appendix T-A.1 lists no login, no route and no parameter key; the context pack P10 gives schema rwb_agent, base /api/recovery/agent/v1, topic rwb.agent.events.v1 and queue rwb-agent but no login, route or parameter key.
owner_role: TechX (suggested; any team may pick up this story)
proposed: Name the rwb-agent login in the ACE DB story, publish the S8 raise story, fix the three parameter keys with rwb-case, fix the route in the gateway-bff contract, and record the Flyway position of rwb_agent; until then the story uses the placeholders and the assumed shapes and builds no code value.

title: RWB-P10-E2029-CON: contract detail the sources leave open for the screening key
source: Template and Rules v1 §R9; legacy RWB E2 029 v1 §12; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 Appendix T-A; context pack P10
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC5 and AC6; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.7 Tables owned; 13 Solution plan
description: Five contract elements are not fixed by any read-only source: (1) the members of the rwb-deviation raise and its answer, beyond the legacy Java signature; (2) the operation that reads a sealed decision-log entry from rwb-decision; (3) the five score-row members beyond the baseline AgentEvaluation, taken from TSD P10 T3.1; (4) the run facts and the two segment members of the rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1 payload, which no source names; (5) the gateway-bff route name and path in front of the operations.
evidence: TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 Appendix T-A.2 gives purpose, request, response, errors and idempotency but no member list for the raise, no entry read and no route; the Event and Messaging extract is not a source of this key's payload members; legacy RWB-E2-029 v1 §12 gives only the Java signature and the returned deviationId and decisionLogEntryId.
area: Agent runtime / API and event contracts
owner_role: TechX (suggested; any team may pick up this story)
proposed: Publish the raise and entry-read shapes with their owners, register the completion payload subject, fix the route in the gateway-bff contract and confirm the five score-row members with the data steward; the fakes are written to the assumed shapes until then.
